title: Are condylar head and neck inclinations associated with condylar volume changes following maxillomandibular advancement surgery?
html: The aim of this study was to analyse the association of condylar head and condylar neck inclination with condylar volume changes 2 years following maxillomandibular advancement surgery (MMA) for prediction purposes. A novel method for assessment of the condylar head and neck inclination from cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) was proposed and its reliability was assessed. The intra- and inter-observer reliability of the method was excellent, intraclass correlation coefficient >0.99, with mean absolute differences ranging from 0.7 to 1.5°.
